data.title: Thai farmers, fishermen challenge IMF, World Bank at Bangkok rally
data.description: BANGKOK (THAILAND) - Thai farmers, fishermen and workers marched through Bangkok Friday as global finance and business leaders gathered for IMF and World Bank meetings, demanding a say in policies shaping their livelihoods.

data.title: Why India's voter revision drive has stoked fear and anger
data.description: NEW DELHI (INDIA) - India's sweeping overhaul of electoral rolls has triggered a political firestorm, with opposition parties accusing the Election Commission of putting millions at risk of disenfranchisement.

data.title: Families of children killed in Pakistan school roof collapse demand justice
data.description: PESHAWAR (PAKISTAN) - The families of children killed in a roof collapse at a school in northwest Pakistan called for "justice" on Friday, a day after more than 30 pupils and a teacher were crushed to death.

data.title: In Malaysia, frustration grows over Indonesia haze
data.description: KUALA LUMPUR - Closed schools, shuttered sports centres and mass mask handouts. Indonesian wildfire haze has caused a regional pollution crisis and prompted growing frustration in neighbours, including Malaysia.

data.title: Asian stocks rise as tech bounces from rout, Fed boss upbeat on AI
data.description: HONG KONG - Most Asian markets bounced Friday after the previous day's tech rout fuelled by concerns over the AI boom, which Federal Reserve boss Kevin Warsh said offered huge benefits to the global economy.

data.title: Trump's new press secretary says China lacked 'proper' toilets
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia, who was appointed less than a week ago, said China lacked "proper toilets" in an interview that aired on Thursday.

data.title: India closes down New Delhi park ahead of 'cockroach' movement rally
data.description: NEW DELHI (INDIA) - Authorities closed a central New Delhi park Friday before a fresh protest seeking the removal of India's election chief over a voter-roll revision that critics say has disenfranchised millions.

data.title: 'Let us build': World Bank chief outlines jobs-led development agenda
data.description: BANGKOK (THAILAND) - World Bank President Ajay Banga laid out a vision on Friday for how his multilateral development giant should operate, focusing primarily on creating jobs, expanding economic opportunity and connecting private capital to developing nations that need investment.

data.title: Fed's Warsh surprised by world economy's 'resilience'
data.description: BANGKOK (THAILAND) - US Federal Reserve boss Kevin Warsh said on Friday, the global economy had shown unexpected resilience against strong economic shocks, as central banks battle surging inflation, while rich countries tackle spiking bond yields.

data.title: Four killed in Indonesia battling fires causing toxic haze
data.description: JAKARTA (INDONESIA) - Four people died on Indonesia's Java island fighting the blazes that have been sending toxic smoke across southeast Asia, closing schools and fuelling a surge of respiratory complaints in the region, authorities said on Friday.

data.title: Le Pen looms large as Macron enters final months on EU stage
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - The spectre of far-right leader Marine Le Pen winning France's presidency with a pledge to go head-to-head with the European Union is already giving Brussels the jitters -- and looming large over Emmanuel Macron's final months in power.

data.title: 'Mixed feelings': AI cracks centuries-old ciphers
data.description: TOKYO - Napoleon Bonaparte ordered the wartime missive written in code, creating a puzzle that went unsolved for more than 200 years -- until AI cracked it in a matter of hours.

data.title: 'Multiple victims' in Oregon elementary school shooting
data.description: LOS ANGELES - A shooting at an elementary school in the northwestern state of Oregon on Thursday left "multiple victims," police said, with several media outlets reporting three children and one adult had been killed.

data.title: Argentine protesters, police clash at demo over university funding
data.description: BUENOS AIRES (ARGENTINA) - Argentine demonstrators clashed with police on Thursday at a major protest in Buenos Aires over budget-slashing President Javier Milei's education spending.

data.title: Somalia sets May presidential election despite insecurity
data.description: MOGADISHU - Somalia announced on Thursday that parliamentary and presidential elections would be held next year in the deeply fragmented country that faces a long-running Islamist insurgency.

data.title: Carney campaigns for Canadian unity before Alberta secession vote
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney campaigned for national unity in Alberta on Thursday, before the oil-rich province votes on whether it wants a binding independence referendum.

data.title: Houthis launch deadly attack on presidential palace in Yemen's Aden
data.description: ADEN - The Houthis launched a deadly missile attack Thursday on the presidential palace in the Yemeni government's interim capital of Aden, as Saudi Arabia blamed Iran for the recent dramatic escalation in the long-running war.

data.title: Venezuela's Maduro denies US torture charges as 'false accusations'
data.description: NEW YORK - Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty Thursday to new torture charges brought against the pair held in US custody since their extraordinary capture in January.

data.title: France, Germany reach deal on future of car industry
data.description: BRUSSELS (BELGIUM) - France and Germany have backed a further scaling down of EU emission rules for cars as part of a long-negotiated deal on the automotive industry struck Thursday, diplomatic sources confirmed to AFP.

data.title: Albanian PM condemns 'chaos' surrounding violent protests
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Protesters and police clashed in Albania's capital on Thursday, the third straight day of violence, with prime minister Edi Rama condemning "chaos" that has left government buildings badly damaged.

data.title: 'I couldn't breathe', Russell Brand's alleged rape victim says
data.description: LONDON - A woman allegedly raped by British comedian Russell Brand more than two decades ago has recalled how she was left scared and "felt dirty" after being attacked in her hotel room.

data.title: Pope's cancer operation already reshaping papacy
data.description: ROME - With Pope Leo XIV recovering in hospital on Thursday following his lung cancer operation, questions are swirling about how the illness could change his papacy, less than two years after his election.

data.title: Zelensky defies Trump with Russian refinery strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Ukraine will no longer abide by US President Donald Trump's demands not to strike Russian oil refineries, President Volodymyr Zelensky said in remarks published Thursday, amid deepening tensions between the two leaders over a US-Russia diesel agreement.

data.title: Embattled Albanian PM tours protest aftermath
data.description: TIRANA , Albania - Protesters and police clashed in Albania's capital for a third straight day on Thursday, when the prime minister toured the aftermath of demonstrations that left government buildings badly damaged.

data.title: ‘No place to breathe’: life in Indonesia’s fire epicentre
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Irvan Maulana has struggled with shortness of breath and a cough as wildfire smoke cloaks the Indonesian city of Palangkaraya in West Kalimantan. But he is a doctor, and patients keep arriving.

data.title: ‘Can’t sleep’: Spain’s housing crunch upends lives
data.description: MADRID - At 38, Nadinne Fillol has a job, a partner and hopes of having children.

data.title: School roof collapse kills 28 people in Pakistan
data.description: PESHAWAR, Pakistan - Twenty-seven pupils and a teacher were killed on Thursday after a roof collapsed at a school in the northwest Pakistani city of Peshawar, a hospital official said.
